title: Architecting Scalable React Component Hierarchies
author: test name 1
summary: Master compound components, props destructuring, and container-presentational patterns for production apps.
content: Designing clean React architecture requires balancing reusability with developer velocity. Avoid premature abstraction and favor explicit prop interfaces over deeply nested render trees.

title: CSS Grid Subgrid: The Layout Superpower You Overlooked
author: test name 2
summary: Align child elements across nested grids effortlessly without hacky height synchronizations.
content: Subgrid allows a grid item to inherit the grid tracks of its parent. This fixes the age-old problem of misaligned card headers and footers across different screen dimensions.

title: Mastering JavaScript Memory Leaks & Event Loop
author: test name 3
summary: Dive into V8 garbage collection, closures, timers, and microtask queue mechanics.
content: Dangling event listeners and uncleaned setInterval callbacks quietly consume client memory. Discover profiling workflows using Chrome DevTools memory allocation snapshots.

title: HTML5 Semantic Accessibility: Beyond Div Soup
author: test name 4
summary: How landmark roles and native semantic tags transform screen reader experiences and SEO indexing.
content: Using <main>, <article>, and <section> tags isn't just about clean syntax; it structures the browser's accessibility tree so screen readers can jump directly to landmark sections.
